label: Mitral valve surgery
summary: Surgical repair or replacement of the mitral valve on cardiopulmonary bypass. It is the definitive treatment for papillary muscle rupture.

levers.why: A competent valve ends the regurgitant volume, lowering filling pressures.

nursingPriorities: Provide post-cardiac surgery care: bleeding, signs of tamponade, rhythm and pacing wires.
A mechanical valve needs lifelong warfarin; teach INR monitoring and bleeding precautions.

relations.why: The valve is repaired or replaced.
A ruptured papillary muscle is addressed as part of the repair or replacement.
